usageNotes: Removes the Proxmox VE subscription key registered on the specified node. Once deleted, the node loses enterprise repository access and support entitlements until a new key is applied via PUT /nodes/{node}/subscription. Requires Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}; the operation returns null synchronously (no UPID — it is not async).

examples.summary: Remove the subscription key from node pve1

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the subscription key from the node, immediately revoking access to the enterprise apt repository and any associated support contract entitlements until a valid key is re-applied.
tips: This call returns null on success — no response body to parse.
After deletion, the node will fall back to the no-subscription or test repository; update /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pve-enterprise.list accordingly to avoid failed apt updates.
To replace a key rather than simply remove it, use PUT /nodes/{node}/subscription with the new key directly — you do not need to DELETE first.
In a cluster, the subscription key is per-node; you must call this endpoint once per node if cleaning up across the cluster.
